basis: binding constraint is demand 5.580B at epochs=1, not the extension target; supply 7.566B covers it 1.36x and the weight does the downsampling (same shape as zh_web 21.29B/1.65B). No failing case: the shortfall vs the 7.77B extension target costs nothing at the mixer.

item: launch on caches without near-dedup (12% near-dup)
basis: bounded efficiency cost, not a correctness failure; stage 1 exists for the early read. Condition: the stage-2 MinHash re-stamp must be a hard gate (t48/44-1), not a plan item -- if it slips, the 12% (CI up to 24%) compounds into stage 2. Weak caveat: the 12% was measured on the 197-shard set; the 235-shard final is unmeasured but same-source.

(a) 60K tok/s as an instantaneous per-step tripwire false-positives on short-seq batches (bucket mix varies step to step); needs a sustained window (e.g. 50-step rolling mean < 60K). (b) loss-by-300 as an absolute threshold is mix-dependent (code-heavy stage-1 loss scale != the 3.24B baseline); must be loss-vs-baseline-curve at matched steps. NaN/50 is right as-is. The three cover the runtime space (divergence/throughput; data-plane is pre-launch gated, quality is milestone-gated).
